WHY.Improved Corruption: Cuts Corruption's cast time (instant at 5/5) and adds up to 10% damage. Between the 26 respec and 5/5 again, Corvin's Corruption has a cast time again (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 14–18 before the respec; 31, 42–45 after it · Icy Veins Affliction: 14–18 · Icy Veins Demonology: 45–49 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 10–14.
WHY.Soul Siphon: Mobalytics' drain-tank core: Drain Life heals more for each of your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony on the target (Official Nov 10 hotfix). Levels · Icy Veins Affliction: 55–57 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 30–32.
WHY.Shadow Mastery: Your biggest Shadow damage boost: up to 10% more Shadow damage and life drained. Not in the Mobalytics respec build. Levels · Icy Veins Affliction: 46–50 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 35–39.
WHY.Soul Link: The pet takes 30% of all damage you take and you deal 3% more; keep it on at all times (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). wowfdb: until you have it, Demonology is “a worse Affliction”. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 30 · Icy Veins Demonology: 30.
WHY.Demonic Pact: The 31-point talent: your Sacrifice buff survives summoning a new demon (wowfdb). Mobalytics: summon the Imp, sacrifice it for 15% Shadow damage, then summon the Succubus. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 41 · Icy Veins Demonology: 40.
WHY.Demonic Brand: Searing Pain marks the target for your pet's next 6 attacks (wording changed Oct 9) and halves Searing Pain's threat. Mobalytics: keep it up with the Searing Pain + /petattack macro; it gives the Succubus the threat to tank. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 26–27 · Icy Veins Demonology: 25–27.
WHY.Demonic Sacrifice: Sacrifice your demon for a 2-hour buff that depends on the demon; summoning a demon removes it until Demonic Pact. Mobalytics and Icy Veins Demonology take it on the way to Soul Link and use it from Demonic Pact (Mobalytics sacrifices the Imp); Icy Veins' Affliction plan ends its Demonology dip with it and sacrifices the Felhunter. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 29 · Icy Veins Affliction: 41 · Icy Veins Demonology: 29.
WHY.Stormstrike: The spec starts here (Icy Veins, wowfdb). Nicktew: keep Earth Shock separate for interrupts (Nov 4, read Nov 7). Levels · Icy Veins: 25 · Nicktew: 25 · Mobalytics (Yebb): 25 · Your notes: 25. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew
WHY.Shamanistic Focus: Shocks and Lightning Shield cost 45% less mana: you stop rationing shocks (wowfdb). Only applies once the point is actually spent, not automatically at 20 (Nicktew, Nov 4, read Nov 7). Levels · Icy Veins: 20 · Nicktew: 20 · Mobalytics (Yebb): 20 · Your notes: 20. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew
WHY.Improved Stormstrike: Dodges and parries can reset Stormstrike; also 50% mana regen while casting (wowfdb). Levels · Icy Veins: 30–31 · Nicktew: 30–31 · Mobalytics (Yebb): 30–31 · Your notes: 30, 32.
WHY.Water Shield: Restoration talent; its value versus earlier deep Enhancement is explicitly untested (Nicktew, updated Nov 4, read Nov 7). Icy Veins' text says 42, but its own calculator places it at 43 because Restoration needs 10 points first. Levels · Icy Veins: 43 · Nicktew: 43. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew
WHY.Maelstrom Weapon: Each stack cuts your next Lightning Bolt's cast time and mana by 20% at every rank, so 5 stacks make it free and instant; more ranks only raise the proc rate (6 to 10 a minute, Official Nov 10 hotfix). Levels · Icy Veins: 47–51 · Nicktew: 47–51 · Your notes: 36–40.
WHY.Rage of the Farseer: +30% attack speed for 25 s on a 3-minute cooldown (wowfdb; marked unconfirmed there). Levels · Icy Veins: 52 · Nicktew: 52 · Your notes: 41.
WHY.Malevolence: +5% Shadow crit at 5/5; pairs with Pandemic. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 56–60 · Icy Veins Affliction: 27–29, 42–43 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 48–52.
WHY.Wrack: Channel that makes your Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony on the target tick twice as fast while you channel (Official Nov 10 hotfix, damage cut 30%). Affliction's 31-point talent; needs Siphon Life. Not in the Mobalytics builds. Levels · Icy Veins Affliction: 51.
WHY.Suppression: +1% hit and 4% less threat per rank (5% and 20% at 5/5). Corvin already has 4/5 (spent at 10–13). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 10–13 before the respec; 46–50 after it · Icy Veins Affliction: 10–13 · Icy Veins Demonology: 41–44 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 15–19.
WHY.Unholy Power: +10% damage for all your demons (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 19–23 before the respec; 26 after it · Icy Veins Demonology: 10–14 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 41–45.
WHY.Demonic Energies: Keeps your demon alive and in mana: you heal it for part of your spell damage and Life Tap feeds it (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 24–25 before the respec; 26 after it · Icy Veins Demonology: 15–16 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 46–47.
WHY.Fel Vitality: +15% demon Health and Mana and +15% of your own Mana (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 26 (re-spent at the 26 respec) · Icy Veins Affliction: 38–40 · Icy Veins Demonology: 17–19 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 53–55.
WHY.Master Summoner: Demon summons 4 sec faster (and cheaper) (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 26 (re-spent at the 26 respec) · Icy Veins Demonology: 23–24.
WHY.Improved Sayaad: A little more Lash of Pain damage and pet threat; Mobalytics says these 3 points can go elsewhere in Demonology. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 26 (re-spent at the 26 respec).
WHY.Fel Domination: Near-instant resummon: when the Succubus drops below about 20%, Fel Domination + a new Succubus beats Health Funnel (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 28 · Icy Veins Demonology: 28.
WHY.Demonic Knowledge: Spell damage equal to your level for you and your demon while a demon is out (30 at level 30, 45 at 45) (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 32–34 · Icy Veins Demonology: 31–33.
WHY.Demonic Embrace: More Stamina; Mobalytics says this 1 point can go anywhere in Demonology. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 35 · Icy Veins Affliction: 31–35.
WHY.Master Demonologist: A bonus for you and your demon depending on which demon is out; Mobalytics takes it for the Succubus' 10% Shadow damage. Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 36–40 · Icy Veins Demonology: 35–39.
WHY.Pandemic: Bigger crits on your DoTs and Drains; better the more crit you have (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 51–53 · Icy Veins Affliction: 22–24 · Icy Veins Demonology: 53–55 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 33–34, 40.
WHY.Improved Bane of Agony: Up to 10% more Bane of Agony damage (Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10). Levels · Mobalytics respec 26: 54–55 · Icy Veins Affliction: 20–21 · Icy Veins Demonology: 51–52 · Mobalytics Affliction 1-60: 56–57.

PATH_NODES.title: Respec to Demonology (Mobalytics)
PATH_NODES.body: Before you respec: visit the Warlock trainer and learn Searing Pain Rank 2 (the same visit also has Curse of Tongues R1, Life Tap R3 and Detect Invisibility R1). Then reset your talents (all 16 points, including the 4 Suppression) and spend 17 points in the Mobalytics Demonology order: Unholy Power 5, Demonic Energies 2, Fel Vitality 3, Master Summoner 2, Improved Sayaad 3, Demonic Brand 2/3 (3/3 at 27). From now on the Succubus is your demon: Searing Pain + /petattack brands her target and lets her tank. Corruption has a cast time again until Improved Corruption is back to 5/5 at 45 (1/5 at 31). Next: Fel Domination 28, Demonic Sacrifice 29, Soul Link 30; ends 20/31/0 at 60. Cost: a respec costs gold and the fee climbs with each use (TechRadar, Oct 10); the exact amount isn't published.
PATH_NODES.src: Mobalytics Warlock Leveling Guide (Crix), Demonology Respec LV 26 variant, updated Nov 10 2026, read Nov 10 2026; trainer table (TRAINER_RAW 26); TechRadar Oct 10 (respec cost)

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: No talents yet
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: Shadow Bolt, Imp, wand at 5 (Enchanting). Voidwalker at 10. Official Nov 6 live: Voidwalker base health +~40. Official Nov 10 hotfix: Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus and Incubus base health +~15%.
PATH_NODES_ICY.src: Kaivax Nov 6 hotfixes + Kaivax Nov 10 hotfixes

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: Affliction starts
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: First 4 points into Suppression (4% hit), then Improved Corruption 14-18 (Icy Veins). With Legacy Talented maxed, points start up to 5 levels earlier.

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: Siphon Life
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: Siphon Life at 30: another instant Shadow DoT that heals you. Weak when first taken, so use it on mobs that will live through most of it. Felhunter class quest at 30.

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: Dual Spec: Demonology as Spec 2 for groups
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: Not a leveling switch. Spec 1 stays Affliction for questing; Spec 2 gets Icy Veins' Demonology order (31 points, Demonic Pact) for dungeons and raids. No respec cost after this.
PATH_NODES_ICY.quote: keep Affliction to 40, take dual specialization when it unlocks, and treat your second spec as the group spec.

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: Demonic Sacrifice
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: Spec 1's 11-point Demonology dip ends here. For solo play sacrifice a Felhunter: 3% of max health every 4 sec for 2 hours, removed when you summon a demon.

PATH_NODES_ICY.title: Wrack, the Affliction capstone
PATH_NODES_ICY.body: A 6-second Shadow channel that also makes your other Shadow DoTs deal 10% more while it's up. Best with Corruption, Bane of Agony and Siphon Life ticking. It doesn't heal, so keep Drain Life for health. Official Nov 6: Tuesday Nov 10 hotfixes will make those DoTs worthwhile with Wrack (reports said Wrack-only was better); Affliction total DPS stays the same — numbers TBD.
PATH_NODES_ICY.src: Icy Veins Affliction leveling (Abide), Nov 3; Kaivax Class Tuning Nov 6

Official Nov 10 hotfix (live): Stormstrike 100% weapon damage on an 8 s cooldown (was 150% on 6 s); Mental Dexterity 33/66/100% of Intellect as Attack Power (was 50/100/150); Maelstrom Weapon 20% per stack at every rank, 6-10 procs a minute by rank (slow weapons proc more per swing). Blizzard: Enhancement leaned too hard on Spell Power/Intellect gear and away from Windfury, so this is fixed before raids. Collect Strength and Attack Power gear. https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-hotfixes-november-10-2026/2403040/6

Troll Berserking (from level 1): +10% attack and casting speed for 15 s (Official), 3 min cooldown (Unofficial, client). Press it on elites, dangerous pulls and dungeon packs, with Stormstrike up from 25; it is a speed buff, so it pays most while swinging and shocking, not while running. Your bar has it on key 9 (vault EllesmereUI Zanjiro note, Nov 9). Whether it is off the global cooldown in Forever is not published. Race advice: Icy Veins Enhancement PvE (Wordup, stamped Nov 9; the Icy Veins leveling guide gives no race advice): race differences are small; 'Troll is also a strong contender through Berserking'. Nicktew (Mobalytics, race section read Nov 7; page updated Nov 8, order unchanged): no reason to reroll Orc (Blood Fury/Shatter Curse utility); no Troll-specific advice. Official Nov 10 hotfix (live): Stormstrike 100% weapon damage on an 8 s cooldown (was 150% on 6 s); Mental Dexterity 33/66/100% of Intellect as Attack Power (was 50/100/150); Maelstrom Weapon 20% per stack at every rank, 6-10 procs a minute by rank (slow weapons proc more per swing). Blizzard: Enhancement leaned too hard on Spell Power/Intellect gear and away from Windfury, so this is fixed before raids. Collect Strength and Attack Power gear. https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-hotfixes-november-10-2026/2403040/6

Icy Veins advises alternating Flame/Earth Shock. Nicktew dungeon3+: prioritize fire totem+Fire Nova, autoattacks for mana and Earth Shock for important casts. Later Stormstrike for regen; Magma26+ only for durable packs. Windfury Totem32+ with Flametongue Weapon is Nicktew group alternative; since the Official Nov 10 hotfix weapon imbues and Windfury Totem work together, so your own Windfury Weapon and the totem can both proc. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Troll Berserking (from level 1): +10% attack and casting speed for 15 s (Official), 3 min cooldown (Unofficial, client). Press it on elites, dangerous pulls and dungeon packs, with Stormstrike up from 25; it is a speed buff, so it pays most while swinging and shocking, not while running. Your bar has it on key 9 (vault EllesmereUI Zanjiro note, Nov 9). Whether it is off the global cooldown in Forever is not published. Race advice: Icy Veins Enhancement PvE (Wordup, stamped Nov 9; the Icy Veins leveling guide gives no race advice): race differences are small; 'Troll is also a strong contender through Berserking'. Nicktew (Mobalytics, race section read Nov 7; page updated Nov 8, order unchanged): no reason to reroll Orc (Blood Fury/Shatter Curse utility); no Troll-specific advice. SETUP12.title: Synapse: switch the profile to the 12-button plate
SETUP12.detail: Buttons send 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 - = (the default; confirm in the Customize tab). Standard mode, Hypershift still off.

SETUP12.title: Action Button 7–12 back to 7 8 9 0 - =
SETUP12.detail: Esc > Options > Keybindings. These are the game's defaults, which the 6-plate setup replaced with Shift-1 to Shift-6.

SETUP12.title: Ctrl layer: bind Ctrl plus every Naga key
SETUP12.detail: Ctrl-1 to Ctrl-= on Action Button 1 to 12, Ctrl-Shift-1 to Ctrl-Shift-6 on the Shift buttons. Defaults put Ctrl-1 to Ctrl-0 on the Pet Bar, which swallows every Ctrl macro.

SETUP12.title: Shift layer moves to the Bottom Right bar
SETUP12.detail: Bottom Right Action Button 1–6 = Shift-1 to Shift-6. It is now six rare-but-combat buttons, not the busy layer it was.

SETUP12.title: Click-only long tail moves to Right Bar 1
SETUP12.detail: From Bottom Right to Right Bar 1 (show it, FadeUI out-of-combat). F1–F6 Bottom Left is unchanged.

SETUP12.title: Keyboard 7 8 9 0 - = are no longer spare
SETUP12.detail: They fire the same buttons as Naga 7–12. Spare keys left near the left hand: F1–F6 only.

MACROS.title: Pet attack and follow
MACROS.does: Sends the pet at your target; Ctrl calls it back without also sending it in (v1 ran both lines on Ctrl). On your Mobalytics path the demon stays out to 60, so this key stays live (Nov 10).
MACROS.src: Your notes; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)

MACROS.title: Curse button (levels 4 to 19)
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:ctrl] Curse of Recklessness; Curse of Weakness
MACROS.does: Plain: Curse of Weakness. Ctrl: Curse of Recklessness (from 14). v1 pressed Curse of the Elements, which you don't have before 20, so the plain press did nothing. No Alt branch: Alt is the default self-cast key.
MACROS.src: Trainer levels; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Swaps to the 20-25 version at level 20.

MACROS.title: Curse button (levels 20 to 25)

#showtooltip
/cast [mod:ctrl] Curse of Recklessness; Curse of the Elements
MACROS.does: Plain: Curse of the Elements (20). Ctrl: Recklessness.
MACROS.src: Trainer levels; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Swaps to the 26+ version at 26.

MACROS.title: Curse button (26+)

/cast [mod:ctrl] Curse of Tongues; Curse of the Elements

MACROS.title: Corruption, mouseover
MACROS.does: Casts on the mob under your cursor, else on your target, so you can spread DoTs without retargeting.
MACROS.src: Your notes

MACROS.title: Amplify Curse + Bane
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip Bane of Agony
/cast [harm,nodead] Amplify Curse
/cast [harm,nodead] Bane of Agony
MACROS.does: Pops Amplify Curse (off the global cooldown) then lands an empowered Bane of Agony in one press.
MACROS.src: wowfdb Affliction macros (marked Untested); level gate fixed by Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Amplify Curse is a talent: level 53 on Corvin's Icy Veins order (it moves if you follow another guide). Not on your Mobalytics path (no Wrack, Siphon Life, Amplify Curse or Curse of Exhaustion in its 20/31/0); kept for the Icy Veins Affliction reference.

MACROS.title: Wrack, no restart
MACROS.does: Wrack only, and a second press can't restart the 6 s channel. v1's Shift branch could never fire (Shift+3 is your Siphon Life key) and /stopattack does nothing for a caster.
MACROS.src: Icy Veins Nov 3 (rotation); Rankedboost WoW Forever macros, updated Nov 4, read Nov 7 2026 (syntax); Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Not on your Mobalytics path (no Wrack, Siphon Life, Amplify Curse or Curse of Exhaustion in its 20/31/0); kept for the Icy Veins Affliction reference.

MACROS.title: Healthstone
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip
/use Major Healthstone
/use Greater Healthstone
/use Healthstone
/use Lesser Healthstone
/use Minor Healthstone
MACROS.does: Eats your best Healthstone, nothing else. v1 sat on a Shift key, so its [mod:shift] branch was always true and it only ever made stones. Making stones moved to F2.
MACROS.src: Your notes; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Stone item names are the Classic names; check your bag after the first Create Healthstone.

MACROS.title: Soulstone
MACROS.does: Ctrl on the Healthstone key: Soulstone your mouseover, then friendly target, then you. Create Soulstone is level 18 (ranks at 30, 40, 50, 60).
MACROS.src: Trainer levels; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Edit 'Minor' to the stone you carry (Lesser 30, plain 40, Greater 50, Major 60).

MACROS.title: Fear, pet pulled off
MACROS.does: Calls the pet off, then Fears your mouseover or target. v1 set the pet passive, so it stayed passive on the next pull.
MACROS.src: Your notes; Rankedboost WoW Forever macros, updated Nov 4, read Nov 7 2026; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)

MACROS.title: Drain Life, no restart
MACROS.does: Drain Life; Ctrl for Drain Mana (24). Neither restarts a running channel, and holding Ctrl during Drain Mana no longer falls through to Drain Life.
MACROS.src: Your notes; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)

MACROS.title: Drain Soul
MACROS.does: Shard farming on a dying mob without clipping the channel.
MACROS.src: Your notes

#showtooltip Life Tap
/cast [mod:ctrl] Health Funnel; Life Tap
MACROS.does: Health to mana; Ctrl heals the pet instead.

MACROS.title: Health Funnel on pet

MACROS.title: Summon any pet
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Summon Voidwalker; [mod:ctrl] Summon Succubus; [mod:alt] Summon Felhunter; Summon Imp
MACROS.does: Every demon on one key. Plain is Imp.
MACROS.src: Your notes
MACROS.flag: If your spellbook says Summon Sayaad or Incubus, swap the name. Used until 20; the Succubus-default version takes over at 20.

MACROS.title: Fel Domination + summon
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip Fel Domination
/cast [nopet] Fel Domination
/cast [mod:ctrl] Summon Voidwalker; Summon Succubus
MACROS.does: When the Succubus dies or drops low, press twice: instant Fel Domination, then a fast Succubus (Ctrl: Voidwalker). Mobalytics: faster than Health Funnel.
MACROS.src: wowfdb Demonology macros (marked Untested); Succubus default per Mobalytics Crix, Nov 10 2026
MACROS.flag: [nopet] only fires Fel Domination with no pet out; dismiss a low Succubus first. If your spellbook says Sayaad or Incubus, swap the name.

MACROS.title: Demonic Sacrifice (Spec 2, dungeon)
MACROS.does: Spec 2 dungeon plan: sacrifice the Succubus, then summon the Imp. Only fires on that pet, so it can't eat your Voidwalker.
MACROS.src: Mobalytics Demonology 2/31/18 (Oct 30); Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: If your spellbook says Incubus or Sayaad, change the pet name.

MACROS.title: Demonic Sacrifice (Affliction solo)
MACROS.does: Affliction at 41 sacrifices the Felhunter for the buff. Only fires on the Felhunter. Summoning any demon afterwards removes the buff, so keep F1 away from it.
MACROS.src: Icy Veins Affliction order (point 32 = level 41); Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: Previous Icy Veins Affliction plan. On your Mobalytics path you sacrifice the Imp instead (see 'Demonic Sacrifice: Imp').

MACROS.title: Soul Fire
MACROS.does: Soul Fire on mouseover or target, always the highest rank. Searing Pain has its own key, so the old Ctrl branch is gone.
MACROS.src: Trainer level 48; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07)
MACROS.flag: The under-35% Soul Fire window needs Decimation, which is in the Mobalytics build but not the Icy Veins Demonology order.

MACROS.title: Searing Pain + pet
MACROS.does: Pet and Searing Pain hit the same mob (mouseover first), so Demonic Brand marks what the pet is on. Mobalytics calls this macro mandatory for Demonology; yours adds mouseover. On your path from the 26 respec.
MACROS.src: Rankedboost WoW Forever macros, updated Nov 4, read Nov 7 2026; Claude macro audit, Nov 7 2026 (vault: Macro Audit 2026-11-07); Mobalytics Crix Demonic Brand Searing Pain macro (#showtooltip /cast Searing Pain /petattack), read Nov 10 2026
MACROS.flag: Assembled from the guide's advice; not a published macro.

MACROS.title: Berserking (Troll burst)
MACROS.does: Troll racial: +10% attack and casting speed for 15 s. Kept on its own key, not folded into Stormstrike, until it is confirmed off the global cooldown.
MACROS.src: Blizzard dev notes Oct 26–27 / Nov 2 (Official, 15 s); cooldown 3 min client data (SKTools, Unofficial); wowfdb Enhancement macros burst line (marked Untested), read Nov 10 2026

Minimum quest level 9. Exact intermediate dialogue-quest order not published in this source. Classic-data FULL same-name Hidden Enemies sequence: quest 5726 insignia→Thrall; 5727 show insignia to Neeru Fireblade, Orgrimmar Cleft of Shadow, then return Thrall; 5728 kill Bazzalan and Jergosh in RFC, return Thrall; 5729 speak to Neeru; 5730 return Thrall and choose reward. LOCATION CONFLICT: Classic 5726 explicitly says Skull Rock east of Orgrimmar, whereas Icy Veins Forever says Razor Hill cavern. Verify current quest marker; do not silently resolve by guessing. ClassicDB marks Side Both, but Forever guide explicitly calls these Horde-only, so faction remains Horde. Sources: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/ragefire-chasm-quests ; https://classicdb.ch/?quest=5726 ; https://classicdb.ch/?quest=5727 ; https://classicdb.ch/?quest=5728 ; https://classicdb.ch/?quest=5729 ; https://classicdb.ch/?quest=5730 · read 2026-11-07

Return to Doan; choose Staff of Soran'ruk rather than Orb. No prerequisite listed in the guide. | Glimmering Staff: Craft with Enchanting 140. Horde formula: Beneris outside west gate of Crossroads, The Barrens,45 Merchant's Favor (formula BoP). Reagents: 4 Large Glimmering Shard,2 Small Glimmering Shard,4 Star Wood,1 Greater Astral Essence,5 Strange Dust,3 Pyrite; Runed Silver Rod. Exact Beneris coordinates not published in opened source. picks.name: Brawler's Leather Gloves
picks.src: Both · Forever client item/recipe + Horde vendor guide, Unofficial · Practical deterministic craft for 15–27, including current 20; NOT a requirement to have already trained Leatherworking 75. Buy Pattern: Brawler's Leather Gloves from Horde vendor Pawani, outside Crossroads west gate, The Barrens (49.6,29.7; vendor location corroborated by existing boots source), 30 Merchant's Favor; pattern BoP. Learn at LW 75; craft 12 Light Leather +3 Cured Light Hide +2 Pristine Leather +1 Fine Thread +2 Shadowgem. Finished gloves BoP/crafter-only; equip requires 15. Comparison: Forever item DB shows 4 Strength/4 Agility/3 Stamina; level 20 guide ranks Gloves of the Fang above these (6 Agility/4 Strength, but random drop), while these give an assured craft once materials/pattern obtained. Choose deterministic craft as primary; Fang is an accessible farm/AH alternative. Gnomish Mechanic's Gloves are a disputed FUTURE Alt, not a level 20 task. Both-faction acquisition corroboration: Alliance counterpart Daniel Stitchsong, Three Corners, Redridge, sells the same LW 75/30 Favor pattern; Horde must use Pawani, not travel to Redridge. Sources: https://db.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/items/252494 ; https://www.wow-professions.com/forever/npc/pawani ; https://foreverwow.gg/shaman/enhancement/level-20/ ; https://metabot.gg/en/wow-forever/items/gloves-of-the-fang ; https://www.wow-professions.com/forever/npc/daniel-stitchsong · read 2026-11-07 Alt — WC farm / AH: Gloves of the Fang. Alt to deterministic Brawler craft. Wailing Caverns, The Barrens: loot Druid of the Fang trash (Classic-data mob level 19–20), or buy the BoE item on AH if listed. Forever DB lists the item as WC random drop and equip 14; one weighted gear page displays 16, so use 14 as item-database requirement with discrepancy noted. Classic-data estimated drop chance 2.3% per Druid of the Fang (MetaBot); not Forever-confirmed and not a guaranteed dungeon run. Forever stats from cited client tables 6 Agility/4 Strength; level 20 guide ranks it above Brawler's Leather Gloves, but this does not prove a universal best choice. https://wowfdb.com/zones/wailing-caverns/loot/ ; https://metabot.gg/en/wow-forever/items/gloves-of-the-fang ; https://foreverwow.gg/shaman/enhancement/level-20/ DISPUTED future Alt, not primary: News for Fizzle: after Martek the Exiled → Indurium, speak to Martek the Exiled, Badlands (42.2,52.7), then turn in to Fizzle Brassbolts, Shimmering Flats, Thousand Needles (78.1,77.1). Forever guide lists minimum 28; generic legacy wiki lists 31. The neutral Classic quest offers the gloves, and Forever BiS lists them, but the Forever quest database currently lists ONLY Fizzle's Zippy Lighter. Confirm the actual reward in game before travelling; not a level 20 pickup. Additional Forever source Eternadex (game data as of Oct 22) explicitly lists BOTH gloves and lighter, and the full Martek the Exiled → Indurium → News for Fizzle chain. This supports gloves reward but does not reconcile the omission in wowdb.wiki or establish live game completion. picks.name: Deviate Scale Belt
picks.src: Both · Forever client recipe/item + guide acquisition, Unofficial · Practical Horde-accessible interim 18–30 belt, not proven level 30 BiS. At 15 accept Deviate Eradication from Ebru above the Wailing Caverns skull entrance, The Barrens (46.4,33.7 per Icy Veins; other DB map pins differ). Climb behind the entrance and drop above the left eye to reach Ebru. Kill 7 each Deviate Ravagers, Vipers, Shamblers and Dreadfangs inside WC; return to Ebru and CHOOSE Pattern: Deviate Scale Belt instead of the other rewards. No prior quest is listed in these sources; confirm availability with Ebru. Learn at Leatherworking 90; craft 10 Perfect Deviate Scale +10 Deviate Scale +2 Fine Thread. Belt is BoE, requires 18: finished item may also be bought/traded if listed. Both factions can take the quest; route is in Horde-side Barrens. Guide comparison: level 20 weighted list places this ahead of Brawler's Leather Belt and Screecher Belt, but below Deadmines Blackened Defias Belt; exclude Deadmines as primary under travel rule. This is a guide-weight recommendation, not a sim/BiS proof. picks.name: Band of Allegiance
picks.src: Horde · Forever guide minimum 30 + Classic-data chain, Unofficial · Service to the Horde from Zor Lonetree, Orgrimmar, after The Lost Report → The Severed Head → The Troll Witchdoctor → Marg Speaks → Report to Zor. Legacy chain begins with the report in Loose Dirt at Swamplight Manor, Dustwallow Marsh (first-step exact object coordinates not verified this pass). Return to Zor and choose Band of Allegiance. Forever level 30 guide lists minimum 30, NOT 20s; full-chain locations/coordinates require in-game verification. Classic-data chain details: Loose Dirt supplies Spy's Report → Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village (The Lost Report); RETURN to Loose Dirt for Defiant Orc Head → Nazeer (The Severed Head); carry head to Kin'weelay, Grom'gol Base Camp, Stranglethorn Vale (The Troll Witchdoctor); bubbling cauldron/Marg's spirit asks for Jeweled Pendant from muckshells, return pendant to Nazeer (Marg Speaks); carry pendant to Zor Lonetree, Orgrimmar (Report to Zor); accept Service to the Horde and choose band. Legacy wiki step gates 33/34/37 differ from Forever guide minimum 30 on final reward: do NOT claim whole chain is completable at 30 without checking actual Forever quest log. Sources: https://www.stillsixty.com/bis/level-30-shaman-enhancement ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Service_to_the_Horde ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Lost_Report ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Severed_Head ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Troll_Witchdoctor ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Marg_Speaks ; https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Report_to_Zor · read 2026-11-07

picks.src: Horde · Forever-data, Unofficial + Classic-data full chain · Hidden Enemies chain: start with Thrall, Orgrimmar (32.0,37.8); recover Lieutenant's Insignia from Burning Blade enemies in the cavern near Razor Hill; follow the Hidden Enemies chain into Ragefire Chasm, kill Jergosh the Invoker and Bazzalan, then complete its reward follow-up and choose Axe of Orgrimmar. picks.name: Rage of the Storm
picks.src: Both · Forever-data, Unofficial · Horde route: at 30 take Call of Air from a Shaman trainer to Prate Cloudseer, Thousand Needles; then Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post. Loot Tattered Note from Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul; return to Rau then Prate. Gather five each Twisted Air (Maraudine centaur, Desolace 37–41), Earth (Lost Ones, Swamp of Sorrows 34–37), Fire (Stonevault troggs, Badlands 39–41), Water (Mirefin murlocs, Dustwallow 35–38). Use Corrupted Totems at hot springs beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle; defeat four elite waves then the final bosses; collect Eye of the Tempest. Return to Rau and then Bath'rah the Windwatcher, Alterac Mountains, to complete The Tempest's Weapons and choose Rage of the Storm. Obtain help or wait: difficult at 30. Alliance has its own route to same weapon; Horde coordinates not published. Existing Nicktew Nov 4 guide discourages this lengthy quest chain; legacy choice retained without claiming Nicktew recommends doing it. Read Nov 7 2026. Sources: https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-forever/shaman-class-quests ; https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew · read 2026-11-07 Alt — Nicktew pick (Nov 8), needs Honored Gelkis: Abandoned Ferocity. Neutral (Horde OK) Gelkis chain, Desolace. First reach Friendly with the Gelkis (kill Magram centaur; Horde pick-up Gelkis Alliance from Gurda Wildmane, Ghost Walker Post 56.3,59.7, Classic location) and report to Uthek the Wise, Gelkis Village 36.2,79.2 (Classic location). Then reach Honored with the Gelkis for the Forever Valley of Bones quests: Saving Our Own → Bone Burying → Checking Things Out → Khan Jehn (quest 93128, from Nerlokh in Valley of Bones; Valley of Bones coordinates not published in the sources read). Kill Khan Jehn in Magram Village (Desolace), turn in to Uthek the Wise and choose Abandoned Ferocity. Requires level 35; quest level 42, from 30; Nicktew suggests 35+ with help, ~40 solo, long chain. Item (Forever data): Rare 2H axe, ilvl 42, 95-143 damage, 3.20 speed (37.2 DPS), +10 Strength, +4 Agility, +12 Stamina. Raising Gelkis lowers Magram reputation. picks.how: Horde route: at 30 take Call of Air from a Shaman trainer to Prate Cloudseer, Thousand Needles; then Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post. Loot Tattered Note from Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul; return to Rau then Prate. Gather five each Twisted Air (Maraudine centaur, Desolace 37–41), Earth (Lost Ones, Swamp of Sorrows 34–37), Fire (Stonevault troggs, Badlands 39–41), Water (Mirefin murlocs, Dustwallow 35–38). Use Corrupted Totems at hot springs beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle; defeat four elite waves then the final bosses; collect Eye of the Tempest. Return to Rau and then Bath'rah the Windwatcher, Alterac Mountains, to complete The Tempest's Weapons and choose Rage of the Storm. Obtain help or wait: difficult at 30. Alliance has its own route to same weapon; Horde coordinates not published. Existing Nicktew Nov 4 guide discourages this lengthy quest chain; legacy choice retained without claiming Nicktew recommends doing it. Read Nov 7 2026.

picks.name: Enchanted Sandals
picks.src: Horde · Forever beta guide + conflicting search-only quest extract, Unofficial · Horde Heart of Disruption reward, NOT the same-name Alliance reward. Key-chain guide: optional Prison Break In → Key to the City (Grimy Key from Warden's Footlocker, Alterac) → Dalaran Patrols (6 Summoners,12 Elemental Slaves) → Blood in the Streets → Heart of Disruption. Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill starts the Horde chain. Kill Shade of the Archmage in City of Dalaran and recover Arcane Mote; turn in and choose Enchanted Sandals. 1mw lists Archmage Modera outside entrance, Silverpine(68.6,45.2), but Wowhead quest 96984 search extract says return to Magus Wordeen in Tarren Mill; VERIFY turn-in in quest log rather than treating these as reconciled. Minimum 24 reward versus 30 key-chain listing is unresolved. Sources: https://1mw.io/en/dungeons/city-of-dalaran/quests ; https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=96984/heart-of-disruption · read 2026-11-07

Rage of the Storm.how: Horde route: at 30 take Call of Air from a Shaman trainer to Prate Cloudseer, Thousand Needles; then Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post. Loot Tattered Note from Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul; return to Rau then Prate. Gather five each Twisted Air (Maraudine centaur, Desolace 37–41), Earth (Lost Ones, Swamp of Sorrows 34–37), Fire (Stonevault troggs, Badlands 39–41), Water (Mirefin murlocs, Dustwallow 35–38). Use Corrupted Totems at hot springs beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle; defeat four elite waves then the final bosses; collect Eye of the Tempest. Return to Rau and then Bath'rah the Windwatcher, Alterac Mountains, to complete The Tempest's Weapons and choose Rage of the Storm. Obtain help or wait: difficult at 30. Alliance has its own route to same weapon; Horde coordinates not published. Existing Nicktew Nov 4 guide discourages this lengthy quest chain; legacy choice retained without claiming Nicktew recommends doing it. Read Nov 7 2026.

Collect 25 Intact Limbs from skeletons and zombies inside Ruins of Lordaeron, Tirisfal Glades; return and choose Spare Part Bindings, not The Stitcher. ROUTES.zone: Valley of Trials · Troll Shaman (same start as Orc), levels 1–6
steps: Kaltunk (43.69): Your Place In The World. Turn in at The Den entrance (42.68), take Cutting Teeth.
Kill Mottled Boars (skin them for Skinning). Take Sarkoth (41.63), kill Sarkoth just south (41.67), turn in and take part 2.
The Den: turn in Cutting Teeth and Sarkoth; take Sting of the Scorpid and the Rune-Inscribed Tablet. Turn the tablet in at the Shaman trainer (42.69) and train.

Take Vile Familiars, Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise (43.67) and Lazy Peons (45.69, level 3). Do them together: Scorpid Worker tails, cactus apples, Foreman's Blackjack on peons, Vile Familiars outside the cave (45.57).
Turn in; next to the Shaman trainer take Call of Earth and your level-4 spells; take Burning Blade Medallion and Thazz'ril's Pick.
Cave (45.56): right side to Yarrog Baneshadow (43.53), left side for Thazz'ril's Pick (44.54), Felstalker hooves for Call of Earth.
Be level 5, hearth, turn in, take Report to Sen'jin Village. Finish Call of Earth at Spirit Rock (44.76) via the Hidden Path (41.74), then leave east.
ROUTES.flag: Classic route. wowforever.one lists Stoneskin Totem as a level-4 trainer spell, which Call of Earth used to grant: check in game whether that quest still matters.

src.label: wowfdb Enhancement leveling, Troll: Valley of Trials, Sen'jin and Razor Hill; Earth totem at 4 from Canaga Earthcaller (Unofficial, read Nov 10)

steps: Up the crypt stairs: Undertaker Mordo (30.72), Rude Awakening. Kill bats and wolves on the way down for junk.
Church (31.66): turn in, take The Mindless Ones; Warlock: take Piercing the Veil and learn Immolate.
North in the village (32.61): Rattlecage Skeletons for Piercing the Veil, turn in, summon the Imp. Zombies down the hill (32.63) for The Mindless Ones.
Church: turn in; take Tainted Scroll, Rattling the Rattlecages and The Damned. Turn in Tainted Scroll at the Warlock trainer.
The Damned (wolves and bats) and Rattlecage Skeletons around 32.60. Turn in, take Marla's Last Wish, train level-4 spells (at least Corruption).
Outside the church (32.66): Scavenging Deathknell (equipment boxes, 32.64) and Night Web's Hollow (spiders, mine at 27.59). Turn in, take The Scarlet Crusade.
Scarlet humans east (37.67); Samuel Fipps (37.62) for Marla's Last Wish, then Marla's Grave (31.65). Turn in.
The Red Messenger: Meven Korgal (37.69). Turn in, take Vital Intelligence; leave NE, A Rogue's Deal (38.57), on to Brill.
ROUTES.flag: Classic route. wowforever.one lists Summon Imp as a level-1 trainer spell, so Piercing the Veil may be gone or optional: check the trainer first.

steps.text: Undertaker Mordo (30.2, 71.7), outside the crypt: Rude Awakening, for Shadow Priest Sarvis in the church.
Venya Marthand, in the church: Piercing the Veil (Warlock only), 3 Rattlecage Skulls from the skeletons north-east.
You start broke: sell a bit of loot to Joshua Kien, then train at Maximillion (30.9, 66.3).
Sarvis: The Mindless Ones (8 Mindless + 8 Wretched Zombies), then Tainted Scroll to Maximillion and Rattling the Rattlecages (12 skeletons).
The Damned (6 Scavenger Paws, 6 Duskbat Wings), Scavenging Deathknell (Equipment Boxes), Night Web's Hollow from Executor Arren.
Level 4: train Corruption and Curse of Weakness at Maximillion.
Night Web's Hollow: 10 Young + 10 Night Web Spiders.
steps.tip: Keep the Night Web Matriarch (5) at the cave's north end out of your pulls.

steps.text: A Light in the Darkness (new in Forever), The Scarlet Crusade (12 armbands), Marla's Last Wish: Samuel Fipps (5) is by the graveyard.
The Red Messenger: Meven Korgal, then Vital Intelligence and The Adventurer for Brill.
On the road east: A Rogue's Deal (Calvin Montague), Fields of Grief (Deathguard Simmer), Gordo's Task (Gordo walks the road).
Brill: Vital Intelligence to Executor Zygand. Keep At War With The Scarlet Crusade in the log; its 4 parts run to 12.
Eleanor Shackleton (57.3, 55.5): The Adventurer, Sticks and Bones, The Great Outdoors (sit at her fire about a minute), Camping 101: Cooking. All new in Forever.
Level 6: train Life Tap and Shadow Bolt rank 2 at Rupert Boch (61.6, 52.4, upstairs in the inn). Make Innkeeper Renee your home.
Discipline and Patience (Zygand, new), A New Plague (Apothecary Johaan), A Putrid Task, Hides for the Forsaken (Shelene Rhobart, Balnir).
West loop: Putrid Claws, darkhound blood and hides, Gloom Weed, pumpkins, 10 Scarlet Warriors, Seeking Refuge.
steps.tip: Cursed Darkhounds roam among the darkhounds; three Scarlet Warriors stand together on Bareth Dawnstone's top floor.

steps.text: Hearth to Brill. Grimoire of Blood Pact (Rank 1) from Gina Lang (61.5, 52.6) for the Imp.
North: Graverobbers and Doom Weed at the Rot Hide gnoll camps, Vile Fin murlocs on the coast. Loot every Agamand Mills undead for A Letter Undelivered.
Level 8: train Bane of Agony and Fear.
Voidwalker: Halgar's Summons from Ageron Kargal (upstairs in the Brill inn). Your notes: this Undercity-side quest is much easier than the Orc and Troll one.
steps.tip: Creature of the Void: Egalin's Grimoire is in Perrine's Chest beside Captain Perrine (51.1, 67.6).

steps.text: Level 10: train Drain Soul, Create Healthstone, Demon Skin 2, Immolate 2. Spend your first talent point.
Balnir Farmstead: The Cult of the Damned and Remnants of War (new), Rear Guard Patrol, Tomb Weed.
steps.tip: Dark Enforcers (10-12) hit hard with an instant strike. Fight at full health.

steps.text: Maggot Eye, then Agamand Mills: Deaths in the Family, The Haunted Mills, The Mills Overrun. Gunther's island: The Lich's Spellbook.
Captain Vachon's camp at the Crusader Outpost: keep the Linen Cloth. Bind on Forever calls it the last good source before Silverpine.
Level 12: train Health Funnel, Shadow Bolt 3, Curse of Weakness 2. Proving Allegiance (Lillith Nefara, 12), Captain Melrache, The Family Crypt.
Delivery to Silverpine Forest from Johaan, then out through the Undercity.

meta_raid_watch.text: Official Nov 11 hotfixes (posted 7:48 PM ET): Flametongue Totem Rank 2 fixed; Woolen, Silk and Mageweave bags need more bolts but hold more slots; Retribution's Unsealed Fury no longer echoes Windfury Totem; Auction House changes moved to the Nov 17 maintenance. Official Nov 10 hotfixes: Enhancement rework (Stormstrike 100% weapon damage on 8 s, Maelstrom Weapon 20% a stack with 6-10 procs a minute, Mental Dexterity 33/66/100%, imbues and Windfury Totem now stack, Rage of the Storm now Strength); Warlock demons +~15% health, Imp Firebolt ranks 1-4 up; Affliction Wrack now speeds up your DoTs (damage -30%). feed_rows.detail: Blizzard says Invite-a-Friend issues are resolved. Boats and zeppelins were getting lost; temporary portals sit near the docks until a fix on Nov 5 (Pacific morning), and realm population caps are being tweaked the same day. No class changes. Read Nov 5, 9:20 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Launch build 70790: Chain Lightning 2.5 sec cast is now in the game files
feed_rows.detail: Live build 1.60.1.70790 (detected Nov 4, 18:41 UTC) changes 3 spells and 1 talent versus 70755. For Vorgash: Chain Lightning's cast time is 2.5 sec (was 2 sec), matching Blizzard's official Nov 2 notes, so nothing new to change. The rest is Warrior threat: Defensive Stance and Defiance threat bonuses reverted to 30% and 15% after a same-day hotfix had raised them to 80% and 20%. Read Nov 4, 6:20 PM ET.

feed_rows.title: WoW Forever is live worldwide
feed_rows.detail: Blizzard's launch post: Forever is now live, leveling to 60 across the original continents. Battle.net and Discord account linking is available for guild chat in and out of the game. No class changes in the post. Read Nov 4, 6:20 PM ET.

feed_rows.title: MythicSim: Enhancement up to #3, Demonology slides to #8
feed_rows.detail: Nov 4 snapshot, re-simmed for the Nov 2 notes on engine a667dce. Enhancement #3 (1,066 DPS, was #5 at 982). Demonology #8 (980, was #4): MythicSim now reads Orc Command from the live client as +5% on the Imp's Firebolt and Succubus' Lash of Pain only, and switched the Demonology reference race to Undead. Affliction #11 (934, was #13) after its reference moved to a 35/11/5 Wrack build. Destruction #12 (929, was #11). Elemental #20 (823, was #22). Survival Hunter leads at 1,288. Sims are pre-launch and unverified against the live game. Read Nov 4, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Wowhead level-60 tier list: Affliction and Enhancement drop to A
feed_rows.detail: Wowhead's DPS list was updated for level 60 on Nov 3. Demonology and Destruction stay S (Demonology called the best Warlock spec, Shadow Brand build). Affliction drops S to A (slightly lower throughput, behind Demo and Destro in most fights). Enhancement drops S to A (strong single target and cleave, scales with Spell Power, top totem buffs). Elemental drops B to C. Read Nov 4, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Datamine: 1,265 hotfix rows and 85 new items on build 70755, no Shaman or Warlock spell changes
feed_rows.detail: 1mw.io found 1,265 hotfix changes in the client cache (497 items, 538 spells, 211 creatures) and 85 new items, mostly raid legendaries and epics such as Thunderfury, Sulfuras, Benediction, Anathema and Rhok'delar. Its Nov 4 patch-notes diff shows no spell, talent or item tooltip changes. No new Blizzard Forever hotfix post before launch. Read Nov 4, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Corvin: Wrack more than doubled, Amplify Curse fixed, Drain Soul shards need kills
feed_rows.detail: Wrack base damage at 60 goes from 36 to 86 per second (+2.5 per level) and its spell damage coefficient doubles to 0.286 per second. Amplify Curse now really boosts Bane of Agony and Curse of Exhaustion, and Bane of Agony updates its damage while it runs. Drain Soul's chance to give a Soul Shard from damage (no kill) is cut a lot; kills still give one. Demons now get 2 Health per point of your Stamina (was 7.5), so pets are squishier. Spellstone now boosts Shadow damage only (fine for Affliction, no Fire help for Demonology). Shadow and Flame is 4/8/12/16/20% (was 2-10%). Training 1-60 costs 206-207 gold, with Warlock costs cut by the expected grimoire price. Most of this lands by server hotfix, not yet in the client. Read Nov 3, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Vorgash: Stormstrike 150% on a 6 s cooldown, shocks back to Classic damage
feed_rows.detail: Stormstrike deals 150% normalized weapon damage (was 100%) on a 6 sec cooldown (was 8). Maelstrom Weapon triggers twice as often. Mental Dexterity gives 50/100/150% of Intellect as Attack Power (was 33/67/100). Flurry is 6/12/18/24/30% (was 5-25). All shocks return to Classic Era base damage. Lightning Bolt base damage is up on every rank (top rank +80%); Chain Lightning becomes a 2.5 s cast. Totemic Projection becomes Totemic Call: totems jump to where you stand, 30 sec cooldown. Improved Ghost Wolf moves from row 2 to row 4, so it can't be one of the first leveling points any more. Lava Burst is removed for Call of Thunder (+5% crit on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning) and Elemental Mastery is renamed Lightning Mastery. Read Nov 3, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_notes_out_of_date.text: Shaman - Enhancement (lines 79 and 113) and Shaman - Gear and Dungeons (line 261): Totemic Projection (moves the set 30 yards, 1-minute cooldown) is now Totemic Call: totems jump to you, 30 sec cooldown (Nov 2 notes, official).

Warlock - Affliction (line 198): still lists Malediction 5; it was replaced by Grim Reach in the Oct 15 notes (official).
Drain Soul shard farming: shards now come reliably only from the kill, so channel it as the mob dies (Nov 2 notes, official).

Warlock notes and the dashboard plan (Oct 30 rules: 'levels Affliction, Dual Specs into Demonology at 40'): Jason now follows Mobalytics' Demonology respec at 26 (chat, Nov 10). Vault notes not edited.

talents_enh_bullets.text: Official Nov 10 hotfix (live): Stormstrike 100% weapon damage on 8 s, Mental Dexterity 33/66/100% of Intellect, Maelstrom Weapon 20% a stack at every rank with 6-10 procs a minute, imbues and Windfury Totem now stack. Collect Strength and Attack Power gear; Intellect is worth less as Attack Power now.
Dungeon and raid alternative: Wowhead's 8/33/10 build; its point order isn't published, so it isn't in the planner.
17/34/0 Elemental dip from your notes: Improved Fire Nova is now Trial by Fire 2. Untested theorycraft.
Elemental Mastery is back as the 31-point Elemental talent, so your notes calling it gone are out of date.
Your notes' build (0/51/0): levels 31–41 follow your notes' own reconstruction from the confirmed tree (the notes: no beta guide goes past 30). Pre-launch: no Forever data past 30 yet.

Nicktew Recommended (updated Nov4, read Nov7): separate selectable 6/34/11; existing Icy Veins path remains default. Selecting a guide is not confirmation of in-game respec. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Level20 priority (Nicktew): Lightning Shield before pull; Flame Shock unless reserving the shared Shock cooldown for an interrupt; Searing Totem before melee; Fire Nova on3+; Earth Shock damage/kick; finish with autos. Front-load mana spending, then allow five-second regeneration. Icy Veins retains rank1 Lightning Bolt opener; both options preserved. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Nicktew25+: prioritize Stormstrike, then shocks; full5/5 Maelstrom at51 before relying on instant Lightning Bolt, Rage52. No automatic rotation macro. These levels are Nicktew order, not proof of learned talents. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Nicktew sustain: Mindfulness38–40; Water Shield43 replaces Lightning Shield. Its value versus delaying Maelstrom is explicitly untested; infinite-mana and ~10% shield-damage claims are guide estimates, not verified values. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Training check at20: Ghost Wolf, Frost Shock1, Lesser Healing Wave1, Totemic Recall, Call of the Elements, Searing2, Lightning Bolt4; Healing Stream1 requires Water Totem quest. Purchases/quest completion unknown. Mana Spring/Magma26, Windfury Weapon/Grounding30, Windfury Totem/Chain Lightning32. Fan beta trainer list: https://wowforever.one/classes/shaman/spells/ (read Nov7; verify spellbook).

Guide corrections: Mental Dexterity converts Intellect to AP, Mental Quickness to spell damage; 1.5AP/Int versus2AP/Str is75%, not guide66%. Nicktew text implies improved wolf20 but its order says26–27. Totemic Projection name/cursor macro conflicts with recorded Totemic Call rename; verify live spell before binding. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Official Nov 10 hotfix (live): Stormstrike 100% weapon damage on an 8 s cooldown (was 150% on 6 s); Mental Dexterity 33/66/100% of Intellect as Attack Power (was 50/100/150); Maelstrom Weapon 20% per stack at every rank, 6-10 procs a minute by rank (slow weapons proc more per swing). Blizzard: Enhancement leaned too hard on Spell Power/Intellect gear and away from Windfury, so this is fixed before raids. Collect Strength and Attack Power gear. https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-forever-hotfixes-november-10-2026/2403040/6

Nicktew weapons: prioritize strong slow2h;1h+shield intentional tank/safety choice. At20 Horde: Forsaken Greataxe (Ruins quest), Hammerbone (WC quest), Smite hammer (Deadmines, required18). Upcoming Heavehammer26–30, Striking Staff28–32, Corpsemaker required29, Ravager37; Nick discourages long Rage of the Storm quest. Guide recommendations single-source, not confirmed drops/stats past30. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Nicktew gear/professions: weapon first, Str/Int/AP and enough Stamina; cheap of-the-Gorilla pieces, crafted LW filler. Keep Leatherworking/Skinning and secondary skills; no profession switch. Cheap XP food/health-mana pots and Str/Int buffs; Mana Well/Fish Bowl useful camp choices. Stone+imbue compatibility unverified; do not overwrite imbue automatically. Guide has no full slot-by-slot BiS or profession leveling route. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Coverage caveat: Recommended calculator/order and all accessible text read Nov7; Full Enhance First alternate calculator not accessible and no video watched. No inferred alternate order. Actual equipment, trained ranks and spent talents unknown from level alone. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

Nicktew final Elemental Devastation is1/3, so his prose claim of9% from that choice is not a verified1-point value; tree displays3%/point. Full Enhance First alternate order unverified. Cheap consumables/camps are optional; keep existing professions. https://mobalytics.gg/wow-forever/classes/shaman-leveling-guide-nicktew

talents_level60.text: Corvin now levels on Mobalytics' Demonology respec at 26 (20/31/0 at 60, Crix, Nov 10). Previous plan for reference: Icy Veins' 40/11 Wrack build (Nov 3; Wrack at 51). At 60 for raids, Mobalytics' Oct 30 sim puts Shadow Mastery + Ruin (30/0/21) ahead. Malediction is gone from every row.

talents_brand.text: Searing Pain's Demonic Brand now covers the pet's next six hits, not two, and only Shadow brand hits add threat. On your Mobalytics path it comes with the 26 respec (2/3, 3/3 at 27). Your notes' 60 build and their 45-51 leveling step (Oct 31 edit) keep Malediction 5: swap it for Grim Reach 2 plus 3 flex points.

naga_when_to_swap.text: When three or more Shift binds feel like they should be one press (Enhancement around 32–40, Corvin at 40 with Howl of Terror, Fel Domination and Death Coil at 42). Swap once, at a rest stop, not mid-dungeon. The 12-plate is a 4-row grid, not two columns, so every thumb position is new: expect a couple of sessions of fumbling, which is why the old 1–6 slots stay as close to the top as possible.

naga_setup6.title: Action Button 1–6 = keys 1–6
naga_setup6.detail: Esc > Options > Keybindings. Usually already set; the Naga sends these keys.

naga_setup6.title: Action Button 7–12 = Shift-1 to Shift-6
naga_setup6.detail: Main bar slots 7–12 hold the Shift layer, beside what they modify.

naga_setup6.title: Ctrl layer: bind Ctrl-1 to Ctrl-6 and Ctrl-Shift-1 to Ctrl-Shift-6
naga_setup6.detail: Esc > Options > Keybindings. Give each Naga button's action its second key: Ctrl-1 on Action Button 1, Ctrl-Shift-1 on the Shift-1 button, and so on. The game ships Ctrl-1 to Ctrl-0 on the Pet Bar, so without this a Ctrl macro flips its icon and never fires. Accept the overwrite; pet commands live in macros.
naga_setup6._source: Claude, Nov 8 2026 (Jason: Ctrl icon changes, nothing casts)

naga_setup6.title: Bottom Left bar 1–6 = F1–F6
naga_setup6.detail: Out-of-combat only. Bottom Right is click-only. Right bars off.

naga_setup6.title: Lock bars, Gamepad UI off
naga_setup6.detail: Edit Mode: show the Totem Bar (Shaman) or Pet Bar (Warlock).

profs_note_skinning.text: Skinning route: starter zones to 75, Barrens to 115, Stonetalon and Ashenvale to 150, Thousand Needles to 205, Feralas, Tanaris and Hinterlands to 260, Un'Goro, Felwood and Winterspring to 300.

profs_note_tailoring.text: Expert Tailoring trainer is in the Undercity Magic Quarter. Disenchant every green you don't wear.

profs_note_trainers.text: Trainer ranks corrected: train Journeyman at 50, Expert at 125, Artisan at 200 (ForeverArtisan), not at 75, 150 and 225. The caps are still 75, 150, 225 and 300.

profs_note_slider.text: Every milestone from your notes now sits on the skill slider above: hover a diamond or read the chips under it (tap a chip to jump there). ✓ means the slider has passed it; the orange chip is next.

gear_raid_preview.text: Raid preview (datamined, unofficial): Tier 1 is Felheart Raiment for Corvin and The Earthfury for Zanjiro. Hyjal Summit, Barrow Deeps and Onyxia open Dec 9.

macros_skip.text: Skip these: Dark Pact (removed), Felguard, Metamorphosis, Demonic Circle (not in Forever), and /run lines inside instances, since Forever hides those values from addons.

addons_installed_note.text: Spoken stays silent until you install its voice packs. A beta bug reset addon settings on restart, so restart once on launch night to check your settings stick.
